title: Gas Fire Pit, Fast Wifi, Free Parking, Self Entry!
description:
"Nashville Green Haus"

We are conveniently located providing easy access to all Nashville's greatest attractions! There are many restaurants and shops within walking distance and downtown is only 10 minutes away!  Enjoy the big game on a 65" OLED 4K smart TV with surround sound or a French press sunrise on the front porch swing or nightcap with the pack porch fireplace. This home provides a place for great memories and an unforgettable Nashville experience!

The space
We have three queens, and sofas providing ample sleeping space for your Nashville trip. Getting ready to go out is easy with mirrors in each room.

Guest access
You will have access to the entire house shared only with your guests!

Other things to note
We have a hardline natural gas grill on the back porch ( no propane needed) for you to grill out and enjoy the beautiful weather!
